meta.label: Demo company / Synthetic data
meta.business: Three full-service restaurants with dine-in, takeaway and DoorDash / Uber Eats delivery, plus a shared management office
meta.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year runs November–October; FY2026 = Nov 2025–Oct 2026
meta.cash_week_convention: Consecutive 7-day intervals Sunday–Saturday starting 2026-11-01 (13 full weeks, ends 2027-01-30).
cash_rules: Known commitments (approved payroll, open AP, unreceived POs, pending card/cash/marketplace settlements, accrued sales tax, debt service, recurring contracts) apply in full, deduplicated by overlap key.
Customer receipts and vendor purchases run at the trailing 8-week average from the chosen start week; a week takes the larger of known items and run rate, so nothing is counted twice.
Future payroll = average of the last four funding cycles, funded one day before pay date; future sales tax = trailing monthly average.
Owner distributions, new capital spending and income tax (pass-through LLC) are excluded.
meta.sales_tax_due_note: Due date chosen for the demo; the accrued October liability is OPEN in the tax ledger.
meta.cash_floor_note: Minimum cash floor is a demo assumption, not in the source data.

pnl_monthly.description: QuickBooks GL activity by month, entity (R01–R03, HQ, COMPANY = sum) and account, actual vs the original approved budget. Revenue is net of discounts, comps and refunds; expenses are positive.

kpi_monthly.description: Monthly KPIs per restaurant, HQ and COMPANY: P&L by statement group (actual and budget), prime cost, EBITDA, pretax income, POS sales, checks, guests, labor hours, waste, theoretical menu cost, marketplace and ads; bank cash, AP, sales tax payable and debt for COMPANY.

sales_channel_monthly.description: Toast POS closed checks by channel (DINE_IN, TAKEAWAY, DOORDASH, UBEREATS): checks, guests, gross sales, discounts, comps, net sales and sales tax. Marketplace orders are already inside POS sales.

menu_monthly.description: Served POS lines on closed checks: quantity and net sales by menu item, all channels.

labor_monthly.description: Timekeeping: paid, overtime and scheduled hours, hourly wage expense, active employees and shifts.

waste_monthly.description: Measured ingredient loss at cost by reason.

theoretical_cost_monthly.description: Recipe-driven theoretical ingredient cost (menu, modifiers, packaging, staff meals).

count_variance_monthly.description: Physical count variance at cost (positive = loss).

marketplace_monthly.description: DoorDash and Uber Eats: orders, merchant net sales, commission, promotion fees, service adjustments, net receivable.

ads_monthly.description: Meta and Google: spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, platform-attributed revenue (overlaps; not company sales).

bank_monthly.description: Operating bank: opening, inflows, outflows, closing, transaction count.

bank_type_monthly.description: Bank inflows and outflows by transaction type.

cash_schedule_13w.description: 13-week cash schedule from 2026-11-01 (Sun–Sat weeks): committed items deduplicated by overlap key plus run-rate payroll and sales tax. week_index 0–12.

rows.name: Toast-style POS
rows.usage: Sales and collected staff tips. Main sales grain is served POS lines; refunds separate.

rows.name: Card processor
rows.usage: Cash timing and fees; never incremental sales.

rows.name: DoorDash-style marketplace
rows.usage: Order economics mirrored in POS; use mapping to avoid repeated sales.

rows.name: Uber Eats-style marketplace
rows.usage: Platform-funded promotions reimbursed; marketplace tax retained in this synthetic model.

rows.name: Purchasing and supplier registers
rows.usage: Accepted ingredients create inventory; receipt invoices mirror accounting bills one-to-one.

rows.name: Kitchen and inventory
rows.usage: Quantity and cost subledger; no cooked finished-goods inventory.

rows.name: 7shifts/Homebase-style scheduling
rows.usage: Worked minutes and rates explain hourly payroll; planned shifts are not paid actuals.

rows.name: Gusto-style payroll
rows.usage: Tips settled as liabilities. Payroll expense and bank funding occur on separate dates.

rows.name: QuickBooks-style accounting
rows.usage: Primary financial statements; source accruals reconcile to operations.

rows.name: Bank statements
rows.usage: Cash truth for bank arrivals/debits; sign is positive inflow.

rows.name: Cash drawer and petty cash
rows.usage: Bag dispatch and bank arrival are transfers, not sales.

rows.name: Meta/Instagram/Facebook-style advertising
rows.usage: Attribution can overlap Google; spend equals its accounting bill.

rows.name: Google Ads-style advertising
rows.usage: Use spend for marketing metrics; do not add billing as a second expense.

rows.name: Management planning
rows.usage: Original plan separate from actuals; cash commitment index is not a forecast.

rows.name: Treasury registers
rows.usage: Schedules may contain future contractual dates; actual fields remain blank after snapshot.

data_sources.description: Simulated source systems with table, file and record counts (from metadata/source_catalog.csv).

rows.story: DoorDash commission rate stepped from 23.0% to 26.0% of platform net sales in 2026-06.
Cary (R03) delivery share of POS sales moved from 22.0% (2024-11) to 32.2% (2026-10); company 21.3%.
Durham (R02) waste was $3,399 in 2026-09, vs a $680 monthly median for that restaurant.
Peak overtime: Durham (R02) in 2026-08 with 362 overtime hours of 3,186 paid.
FY2026 net revenue $8,432,773 is +11.7% vs budget, yet pretax income $420,508 is $712,598 below budget: costs grew faster than sales.
